To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the temperature dependence of the critical current density in the CuO planes of YBa2CU3O7-d superconducting films is governed by the temperature dependence of both the superfluid density and the oxygen defect concentration.

the oxygen defects do not play a significant role in pinning, the superfluid carrier density plays a major role, the vortex pinning is of the thermally activated type, and the temperature exponent n is a function of the hole concentration, p.

the temperature exponent n governing the temperature dependence of the zero field critical current density, JC0, in YBa2CuO7-d thin films is determined by the hole content, p, and that p determines the temperature dependence of Jc0(T).
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding the role of oxygen defects in the pinning of vortices in Y123 thin films.
the study of the magnetic flux pinning in the YBa2CuOx superconductors.
understanding the role played by the various defects in pinning the vortices and the nature of the superconducting state.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the pinning in Y123 is dominated by superfluid density.
the Jc0 behavior in Y123 superconductor is dominated by the superfluid density.
the temperature dependence of the zero field critical current density in c-axis oriented Y123 films is dominated by the superfluid density and is not affected by the oxygen defects.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
in the Y123 system, the superconductivity in the CuO 2 planes is strongly affected by the hole content.
the Jc0 behavior in the c-axis oriented Y123 thin films is dominated by the pinning of the magnetic vortices in the CuO planes, the role played by oxygen defects is only a secondary one.
the pinning mechanisms in these materials is governed by the superconducting order parameter.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the Jc0(0) values for the Y123 thin films are not very different from each other, despite the large variation in p-values, and the Jc0 values for the YBa2Cu4O8 (Y124) thin films are comparable to that of the Y123.
the Jc0(0) value is a good measure of the superfluid density and the Jc0(n) value is an indication of the strength of the underlying flux pinning mechanisms.
, in the case of Y123 thin films, the temperature exponent n is a function of the hole concentration p.
